data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for an alphabet slider widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides a vertically listed alphabet slider widget commonly used in phone contact listing pages. Users can select an alphabet by sliding on top of the list or clicking on an alphabet.
use_when: Building contact list pages that require alphabetical fast-scrolling
You need a vertical alphabet selection widget
avoid_when: You need complex non-alphabetical indexing or custom grids
strengths: Easy to integrate into existing lists using a Stack
Supports clicking or sliding to select letters
weaknesses: Limited customization documented beyond text color and font size
data.minimal_example:
Stack(
  alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
  children: [
    ListView.builder(
      itemCount: 50,
      itemBuilder: _getScrollItemBuilder,
    ),
    AlphabetSlider(
      onLetterSelect: _onLetterSelect,
      textColor: Colors.green,
      fontSize: 12,
    )
  ],
)
